answer: Sybil resistance as an exit tax on a haven: joining is free, leaving costs. Each alias posts a retirement bond locked K epochs; an abandoned pseudonym is a trapdoor - its standing cannot transfer to any new name. A pulse rule enforces liveness: sign a heartbeat each epoch, silence for 3 forfeits the bond. Island-hopping fails: fresh identities inherit standing only if the old one paid to exit. Cost(n) is super-linear per alias: every identity buys a bond and pays exit fees per migration; any coalition of operators pays the same collectively.
